name: Market-Structure Breakout (lookback=20)
description: LONG when close breaks above the prior 20-candle high (lagged, excluding the signal candle itself). SHORT is the mirror at the prior 20-candle low. Exit: ATR stop (2.0x, frozen at entry) OR max holding (100 candles), OR an opposite-direction breakout, whichever comes first.
rationale: Structurally distinct from every prior hypothesis: entry is driven by a LAGGED price-structure threshold (breaking a prior range), not a moving-average relationship, an oscillator level, or a volatility compression. This tests whether directional persistence exists after a decisive break of recent structure.
